'''Electromesh''' was a type of [[armor]] known for its resilience against [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] fire.

Commonly worn by [[Nagai/Legends|Nagai]] soldiers into battle, Electromesh was a lightweight, black, form-fitting suit that incorporated small [[power cell]]s that generated an energy field designed to absorb damage from energy weapons.<ref name="NEGWT">''[[The New Essential Guide to Weapons and Technology]]''</ref> Designed for maximum mobility, the armor did little to hamper a Nagai's natural dexterity.

Though created by the mostly isolated Nagai, some of these armor suits could be found in [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Realspace/Legends|space]] around the time of the [[Jedi Civil War]].
